info.x-vendor-api-version: CloudVision Resource APIs (workspace.v1, studio.v1, changecontrol.v1, inventory.v1, tag.v2, softwaremanagement.v1)
info.title: Arista CloudVision
info.description:
Arista CloudVision-as-a-Service (CVaaS) Resource APIs covering the modern Workspace/Studio provisioning flow (create a workspace, push configuration into a Studio, build and validate, submit to create a Change Control, then approve and execute it), device onboarding and decommissioning, tags and tag assignments, and software image/extension management.

Authentication: bearer service-account token. Send Authorization: Bearer <token> on every request.

Source: https://github.com/aristanetworks/cloudvision-apis
info.x-itential-curated: Covers Workspace config/status/build, Studio input configuration, Change Control config/status/approval, device onboarding/decommissioning/inventory, tags and tag assignments, and software image/extension management -- 40 operations across 6 of CloudVision's resource packages. Excludes the "list all" (GetAll) and "get several" (GetSome) operations on every resource, since those are long-lived streaming (chunked NDJSON) responses rather than a single JSON object and don't fit a request/response workflow task, plus every other CloudVision resource package (alerting, dashboards, licensing, identity providers, etc.) outside this scope.

get.summary: Get a workspace's configuration

WorkspaceRequest.description: Asynchronous operation to kick off on the workspace. REQUEST_START_BUILD compiles and validates the workspace's changes (this single call covers build and validate). REQUEST_SUBMIT submits the workspace to the mainline, creating Change Controls as needed.

requestId.description: Unique ID of this request, used to look up its Response in Workspace.responses.

request.description: Set to kick off an asynchronous operation (build, submit, etc.) on the workspace.

excludeNetworkProvisioning.description: Used only during Network-Provisioning-to-Studios migration; leave unset otherwise.

values.description: Map from request ID (see WorkspaceRequestParams.requestId) to its Response.

lastBuildId.description: ID of the last build for this workspace -- use with workspace_GetBuild / workspace_GetBuildDetails.

responses.description: Responses for every request executed so far on this workspace; check the entry keyed by your requestId to see if a build/submit succeeded.

ccIds.description: Change Control IDs created as a result of submitting this workspace.

decommissionRequestIds.description: Map of device ID to decommission request UUID, for devices staged for decommission in this workspace.

state.description: Overall build execution status -- BUILD_STATE_SUCCESS means the workspace built and validated cleanly.

error.description: Set if the build failed early, before per-device results were computed.

authzResult.description: Authorization check result; vendor-defined nested structure preserved as-is.

studioBuildDetails.description: Per-studio build results not specific to a device; vendor-defined nested structure preserved as-is.

hierarchyBuildStatus.description: Hierarchy build results; vendor-defined nested structure preserved as-is.

inputValidationResults.description: Results of the input validation stage; vendor-defined nested structure preserved as-is.

configletBuildResults.description: Results of the configlet build stage; vendor-defined nested structure preserved as-is.

configValidationResult.description: Result of the config validation stage; vendor-defined nested structure preserved as-is.

imageValidationResult.description: Result of the image validation stage; vendor-defined nested structure preserved as-is.

buildStageState.description: State for each build stage; vendor-defined nested structure preserved as-is.

configSyncResult.description: Result of the config sync; vendor-defined nested structure preserved as-is.

studioId.description: ID of the studio, e.g. "studio-static-configlet" for the Static Configlet Studio.

path.description: Path to the input field being set, e.g. [] for the studio's entire root input.

remove.description: Set true to remove the inputs at this path instead of adding/setting them.

inputs.description: Value of the input field at this path, encoded as a JSON string.
Resolved value of the input field at this path, as a JSON string.

value.description: Set to a timestamp to schedule, or omit/null to unschedule.

rootStageId.description: ID of the root stage, i.e. the stage that executes first.

stages.description: Map of stage ID to stage configuration; vendor-defined nested structure preserved as-is.
Map of stage ID to stage configuration and status; vendor-defined nested structure preserved as-is.

start.description: Set start.value=true to execute the Change Control, false to stop it.

schedule.description: Set schedule.value to a timestamp to schedule execution.

approve.description: Whether the Change Control has been approved.

start.description: Whether the Change Control has been flagged to start/stop execution.

error.description: Error from execution, if any. No error implies success once status is COMPLETED.

deviceIds.description: Device IDs this Change Control operates on.

deviceIdToStageIds.description: Map of device ID to the stages that apply to it; vendor-defined nested structure preserved as-is.

creation.description: Who/when created this Change Control; vendor-defined nested structure preserved as-is.

approve.description: Set approve.value=true to approve, false to unapprove.

version.description: Timestamp of the Change Control being approved (from changeControl_Get's change.time), required when approve.value=true -- guards against approving a stale/updated Change Control.

overrideReason.description: User-provided reason to override Change Control validation, if applicable.

requestId.description: A UUID you generate to identify this onboarding/decommissioning request.

options.description: Device-specific options for a third-party device, e.g. {"address": "...", "community": "..."} for SNMP.

hostnameOrIp.description: Hostname or IP at which the device can be reached.

deviceType.description: "eos" for EOS devices; for third-party devices: "openconfig", "snmp", "cvp", "mwm", or "vCenter".

profileName.description: Name of the TerminAttr profile with custom TerminAttr configuration to apply while onboarding.

deviceId.description: Unique device ID discovered via onboarding.
Unique device ID that was discovered via onboarding.

force.description: Ignore pending/in-progress blocking tasks and decommission anyway.

userName.description: Name of the user who decommissioned the device.

featureEnabled.description: Map of feature name to enabled status; a missing feature is assumed off.

ipAddress.description: Current (post-provisioning) IP address of the device.

provisioningGroupName.description: Name of the group/container the device belongs to; "undefined_container" if provisioned but ungrouped.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID; the special ID "" identifies where merged (published) tags reside.

remove.description: Set true to remove this tag when the encompassing workspace merges.

assigned.description: Whether the tag is currently assigned to any element.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID; the special ID "" identifies where merged assignments reside.

remove.description: Set true to remove this assignment when the encompassing workspace merges.

primaryId.description: Device ID (serial number or UUID depending on sub-type); see the vendor docs for the full mapping by type/sub-type.

secondaryId.description: Interface/service ID where applicable; empty for device-level elements.

name.description: Unique identifier for the image/extension, including its file suffix (.swi, .swix, .rpm; Streaming Agent files must contain "TerminAttr").

uri.description: Arista Software Download site identifier, or the CloudVision file server identifier if uploaded via the Software Upload REST API.

devices.description: Devices whose designed image references this software image.

ztpUpgradeRules.description: ZTP upgrade rules referencing this software image; vendor-defined nested structure preserved as-is.

studioTagQueries.description: Studio tag queries referencing this software image; vendor-defined nested structure preserved as-is.

message.description: Status of the latest interaction with Arista's Software Download site.

uris.description: URI paths of software releases available from Arista's Software Download site, usable as RepositoryConfig.uri.

bearerAuth.name: Authorization
bearerAuth.description: Service-account bearer token. Value format: "Bearer <token>". Generate a service account and token in CVaaS under Settings > Service Accounts.
